meta.description: Sharon movers with storage for the gap between selling and buying, or during a renovation. Pickup, storage and delivery from one company. Free quote.

overview: Selling a Sharon house and buying the next one rarely line up to the day. A renovation can push the dates further apart.
We pick up your things, keep them in storage and deliver them when the new place is ready, all with our own crews.
sellingPoints: Pickup and delivery by our crews
Priced by the space you use

servicesBlock.h2: Moving and Storage for Sharon Homeowners
servicesBlock.intro: Storage pairs with a local or long distance move, and packing can go along with it. If you are staging the house for sale, moving part of the furniture out early is a storage job too. Each service is listed below if you need more than one.

whyChoose.h2: Why Sharon Sellers Use Our Storage

cards.title: No Second Company
cards.text: The crew that loads the house also takes it to storage and brings it back later, so you are not renting a truck or hiring another mover.

cards.title: Priced by Volume
cards.text: Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up. A half-empty unit you never fill is not part of the deal.

cards.title: Short or Long Stays
cards.text: Short-term and long-term storage are both available, for a gap of two weeks or one of several months. If the end date moves, the delivery moves with it.

cards.title: Renovation Gaps Covered
cards.text: Doing work on the new house before you move in? Storage keeps the furniture out of the way until the contractors are finished.

faq.q: Can you store our Sharon furniture until the new house closes?
faq.a: Yes. We pick up, store and deliver once you have the keys, so a delayed closing does not leave your furniture with nowhere to go.

faq.q: How is storage priced for a Sharon move?
faq.a: By volume. The manager adds storage to your quote once you share your dates, based on the space your belongings fill. The move itself is quoted alongside it.

faq.q: Do I need my own truck to get things into storage from Sharon?
faq.a: No. Our crews load in Sharon, take everything to storage and bring it back on the date you choose. Every piece is wrapped before it goes onto the truck.

faq.q: Can storage work with a long distance move from Sharon?
faq.a: Yes. Your things can wait in storage before the long trip, and long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate.

faq.q: What should I tell you about my Sharon move dates?
faq.a: The move-out date, the earliest day you could take delivery and any renovation timeline. Those set how long storage runs, and you can push the delivery date if the closing slips. A rough range is enough to start the quote.

faqClosing: Deposit and payment questions are answered on the FAQ page.

closing.h2: Plan Your Sharon Move Around the Closing Dates
closing.body: Share your move-out date and your best guess for the new home. A manager prices the move and the storage together. If you are staging the house for sale first, mention the pieces that should leave early.
